title: Beeftacular
description: A simple modpack for pure vanilla minecraft with shaders and sounds. Personal taste.
body:
# Beeftacular

**Q:** _"What is Beeftacular?"_

**A:** _"A simple modpack for pure vanilla minecraft plus shaders and sounds."_

Plug and play, no unnecessary mods, just better looking (and sounding) Minecraft
I'll try to keep the modpack updated and simple.



Info:
- Pure Vanilla
- Optimized (Game logic is untouched)
- Sounds (Mods)
- Shaders (Personal taste)
    
Recommendations:
- 4 GB of allocated RAM
- A modern GPU
